title: Amplifying Effective CXL Memory Bandwidth for LLM Inference via Transparent Near-Data Processing
authors: Rui Xie; Asad Ul Haq; Linsen Ma; Yunhua Fang; Zirak Burzin Engineer; Liu Liu; Tong Zhang
affiliations: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, Wiseburn Da Vinci Science

problem_statement.en: LLM inference is bottlenecked by the limited effective bandwidth and capacity of CXL-based memory pools, which struggle to keep up with the high demands of model weights and expanding KV caches.
problem_statement.zh: LLM inference 受限於 CXL 記憶體池有效頻寬與容量不足，難以應對模型權重與持續擴張的 KV cache 所帶來的高需求。

key_innovation.en: CXL-NDP, a transparent near-data processing architecture for CXL memory devices that uses a precision-scalable bit-plane layout and transparent lossless compression to amplify effective bandwidth without modifying the CXL.mem interface.
key_innovation.zh: CXL-NDP 是針對 CXL 記憶體裝置的透明近資料處理架構，採用精度可調的 bit-plane 佈局與透明無損壓縮，在不修改 CXL.mem 介面的前提下放大有效頻寬。

key_improvements.en: 43% inference throughput increase, 87% context length extension, 40.3% lower DRAM access energy, 42.1% lower model-load latency, 25.2% weight footprint reduction, 46.9% KV cache footprint reduction.
key_improvements.zh: inference 吞吐量提升 43%、context 長度延伸 87%、DRAM 存取能耗降低 40.3%、模型載入延遲降低 42.1%、權重記憶體占用減少 25.2%、KV cache 記憶體占用減少 46.9%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, LLM Inference, KV Cache offloading
traffic_pattern: CXL.mem load/store, Sequential read, DRAM burst
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, DDR5-6400, CXL Type-3 Memory Expander
